mapper.select: select * from basket_match_official_result where match_id = #{matchId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0 limit 1
mapper.update: update basket_match_official_result set is_current = 0, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and is_current = 1 and is_delete = 0
mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_official_result (match_id, data_version, home_score, away_score, winner_team_id, loser_team_id, is_draw, result_type, effective_time, confirmed_by, confirmed_time, is_current, is_public, revision_no, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{matchId}, #{dataVersion}, #{homeScore}, #{awayScore}, #{winnerTeamId}, #{loserTeamId}, #{isDraw}, #{resultType}, #{effectiveTime}, #{confirmedBy}, #{confirmedTime}, #{isCurrent}, #{isPublic}, #{revisionNo}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
